result:
The rename is live: `billingUrl` is now `billingEndpoint`, with the same value, in the shared config and in all three apps that used it. I've also marked the ticket done.

- **PR:** I opened one PR, #1 on `mono`. CI passed, I merged it, and CD passed on `main`.
- **What changed:** the setting in `libs/shared-contracts`, plus `core-shell`, `sub-route-billing` and `sub-route-reports`. A search finds no remaining `billingUrl` in the repo.
- **Apps start:** all three apps built locally, and each build's contract check passed. I only checked that they build, not that they start.
- **`platformkit`:** nothing there used the setting, so I changed nothing and didn't bump its version.
- **Why one PR:** `shared-contracts` lives in the monorepo and is inlined into each app at build time, so no version bump or lockfile update was needed.
- **Reports app:** `docs/ci-cd.md` says CD only builds and deploys `core-shell` and `sub-route-billing`. So I can't confirm `sub-route-reports` was deployed, only that it builds with the new name.

Nothing was blocked, and the ticket's task list was the only extra step.
